<?php
class ReviewDelegatedReferenceChild10 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
$value = new ReviewDelegatedReferenceChild10();
$items = [&$value];
function reviewDelegatedReference10() { global $items, $value; try { echo "G|"; yield from $items; echo "N|"; $value = null; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewDelegatedReferenceTarget10($first) { echo "D|", $first instanceof ReviewDelegatedReferenceChild10 ? "HELD|" : "BAD|"; $first = null; echo "M|"; }
reviewDelegatedReferenceTarget10(...reviewDelegatedReference10());
echo "E";
purpose: A copied delegated reference cache remains a refcell owner, while by-value SEND snapshots its object before producer mutation of that cell.

<?php
class ReviewDelegatedCowChild10 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
function reviewDelegatedRows10() { $row = [new ReviewDelegatedCowChild10()]; $items = [$row, $row]; try { echo "G|"; yield from $items; echo "N|"; $row[0] = null; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewDelegatedRowsTarget10($first, $second) { echo "D|"; $first[0] = null; echo "X|"; $second[0] = null; echo "M|"; }
reviewDelegatedRowsTarget10(...reviewDelegatedRows10());
echo "E";
purpose: Two delegated occurrences of one nested row become independent by-value parameters; producer and first-parameter writes must preserve the second row and its child.

<?php
class ReviewDelegatedCvA10 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewDelegatedCvB10 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function reviewDelegatedCv10() { try { echo "G|"; yield from ["alpha" => new ReviewDelegatedCvA10(), 0 => new ReviewDelegatedCvB10()]; echo "BAD|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewDelegatedCvTarget10($alpha, $later = 0) { echo "BAD|"; }
$generator = reviewDelegatedCv10();
try { reviewDelegatedCvTarget10(...$generator); } catch (Error $caught) { echo "T|", $caught->getLine(), "|", $caught->getTrace() === [] ? "NOFRAME|" : "FRAME|"; }
echo "M|"; unset($generator); echo "E";
purpose: A surviving CV retains the delegated table after SENT abort; unset releases its first object before forced finally, then frees the independently cached second object.
